candidate_identity.semantic_domain_to_escape: bachikoljunior-blip/note Git history and its rollback/delete-recreate authority
candidate_identity.mechanism: Persist a sequence+digest witness as a Gmail message through a Chat-exposed authenticated connector and read it on a later invocation to distinguish a Git-domain rewind from a world in which the later state never existed.

public_primary_evidence.claim: A standard Google Account provides up to 15 GB of cloud storage shared across Gmail, Drive and Photos; larger storage is obtained through paid Google One or temporary promotions.
When the account reaches its storage limit, Gmail cannot send or receive email; storage is a finite shared account resource.

gate_evaluation.out_of_git_domain: PASS_WITH_SCOPE: Google Account storage is operationally separate from the note Git repository rewind domain; no stronger provider/account catastrophe independence is claimed.
gate_evaluation.automatic_chat_native_write_read: CONCEPTUALLY_AVAILABLE_BUT_NOT_EXECUTED: authenticated Gmail actions exist in the Chat environment, but this comparator role is not authorized to mutate Gmail and no Gmail write was performed.
gate_evaluation.zero_residual_work_protected_manual_exec: PASS_ONLY_AT_ARCHITECTURE_LEVEL: the proposed connector path does not inherently require Work or manual user execution, but role authorization remains a separate blocker.
gate_evaluation.zero_finite_monthly_trial_paid_quota: FAIL: the free route depends on a finite 15 GB Google Account storage allowance; paid Google One is explicitly disallowed by the zero-cost/zero-finite-quota Phase-1 gate.
gate_evaluation.role_write_authority: FAIL: current role-authorized write namespaces are repository comparator/relevance plus own receipt; mutating Gmail would exceed this invocation's authority.
gate_evaluation.monotonic_undeletable_witness: UNPROVEN: Gmail messages are mutable/deletable account content and this slice did not establish an append-only or monotonic anti-rewind property.

comparison_result: EXACT_DISTINCT_NON_ACCEPTED_ROUTE: Gmail is a genuinely different persistence domain from the note Git repository for the scoped rewind threat, but it is not a Phase-1 solution because its free storage is finite, a role-authorized write path is absent, and monotonic/undeletable witness semantics are unproven. It must not be merged with the prior same-domain impossibility bound or with public-archive read-only candidates.
tested_scope: One bounded novelty-comparator leaf: exact candidate decomposition plus current official Google storage documentation. No Gmail mutation, no O mutation, no protected O authority mutation, no Work, no manual-user execution, no quota-bearing experiment, no paid service, no exploration feedback, no scheduler mutation, no retry/backoff/poll, no second optional leaf.
blocker: No accepted independent durability witness yet satisfies all of: role-authorized automatic read/write, independent failure domain, zero finite monthly/trial/paid quota, zero incremental cost, and monotonic fail-closed recovery semantics.
